Usage: wc [options] [FILES...]

Count the lines of files.

Arguments:
      FILES  Files to count.  default ""

Options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env WC_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
  -l, --lines       Count the lines.                                                        env WC_LINES, key lines
